items.quote: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
items.claim: Moses took sacrificial offerings from the Israelites' hands and burnt them on the altar as a burnt offering consecration to the LORD.
items.action: took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar
items.mechanism: burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering
